thread:
**Issue #3733 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #3733: Patch: the account screen as a profile and a settings list: a profile header, match history, and sign-in, notifications and privacy each in its own section
Opened by @jgoetzmann.

### What it does

The account screen becomes two clear things: who you are as a player (a profile) and what you can change (settings). It is laid out like the iPad's Settings app: a list of sections beside the open section on a wide screen, and the list, then the section, on a phone.

It follows the conventions in #3728's `docs/polish/10-menus.md`.

### Where it stands

`/account` (`routes/account.tsx`, `routes/account.css`) is one column:

- email and status;
- rank on both ladders, Constructed and All Random, with the crest, streak and badges;
- a Leaderboard link;
- the record: win rate, W–L–D and games played;
- a "Manage sign-in & account" disclosure that holds the username, secret ID, email, two-step, linked accounts (Google #3025, Roblox #3507) and delete;
- Sign out.

It has no portrait and no match history, and its header notes that it "links no other menu".

### The screen

```
┌───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ (portrait)  Ana#1234  Copy        Constructed ◆ Gold II       │
│             Member since Oct 2026 All Random  ◆ Silver I  🔥3 │
├──────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ ▶ Overview           │  This season   41–30–2   57%           │
│   Match history      │  All time     120–98–5   54%           │
│   Sign-in & security │  Badges  …                             │
│   Notifications      │                                        │
│   Privacy & data     │                                        │
│   Delete account     │                                        │
│ [ Sign out ]         │                                        │
└──────────────────────┴────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

- **The profile header**:
  - the equipped hero portrait (an account cosmetic, #1827) and `name#tag` with Copy;
  - each ladder's crest and division, the season's record (#2255) and the win-streak flame (#2101);
  - when the account was made.
- **Overview**: this season's and the all-time record, the badges, and the Leaderboard link.
- **Match history**: recent games, each with its result, mode, opponent, date and Watch replay, linking into `/replays` (what it already lists). A queue opponent shows as `/replays` shows them today, so a ladder bot stays a player (R1452).
- **Sign-in & security**: username, email (add or change), password and two-step, linked accounts with their names and avatars, and the secret ID behind a Reveal.
- **Notifications**: daily-game email and push (#3727), and anything later.
- **Privacy & data**: what's kept and why (the privacy note and the Privacy Policy link), and the watch rules (#2615).
- **Delete account**: last, in the danger style, asking first as it does today. Sign out sits at the bottom of the list.
- **Each section has its own URL** (`/account?section=…`), so Back and links land on it.

### Acceptance

- Every field and action the screen has today is still reachable, in the section listed above. A unit test lists them.
- Each section opens by its URL, and Back returns to the list on a phone.
- Match history shows recent games with Watch replay. A unit test covers a queue opponent showing as `/replays` shows them.
- The account tests (`routes/account.test.*`, `routes/account-reads.test.*`) and the e2e specs on the account screen move to the new layout. Add the screen's first component spec.
- Screenshots at the tracker's device sizes (#3728) in the pull request.
- Every required check is green.

### Blocked by, part of

Blocked by #3727 and #3728 (the notification settings and the shell). Part of #3726.
````
